# CANDIDATE: PRE_VOTE_GATE_FOR_MARKET_HOLIDAYS

**Filed:** 2026-07-07
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The pre-vote gate for market holidays will prevent the reliance on stale levels by suppressing level_thesis and other directional agents when today_bias.json marks no_trade_day due to a market holiday.

## Mechanism

The gate will check the today_bias.json file for the no_trade_day flag and suppress the level_thesis and other directional agents if it is set. This will prevent the engine from relying on stale levels and reduce the risk of incorrect trades.
